query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage Salesforce leads, contacts, campaign membership, campaign attendance statuses, a campaign-based static list, and MQL lead activity reporting.
query_ground_truth.query: search campaigns and add contact to campaign

requirement_groups.purpose: add the contact to the campaign

query_ground_truth.rationale: Managing campaign membership requires first searching for the campaign and then adding the contact to it.

request.query: search campaigns and add contact to campaign

results.use_case: search campaigns and add contact to campaign
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Retrieve campaigns using EMELIA_LIST_CAMPAIGNS (select target campaign ID(s) by name).
[Optional (if campaign does not exist)] [Fallback]: Create the campaign using EMELIA_CREATE_CAMPAIGN, then re-run EMELIA_LIST_CAMPAIGNS (capture new ID).
[Optional (if avoiding duplicates or doing post-checks)] [Prerequisite]: Baseline membership using EMELIA_LIST_CAMPAIGN_CONTACTS (paginate by page until all contacts collected).
[Required] [Step]: Add each person using EMELIA_ADD_CONTACT_TO_CAMPAIGN (provide campaign "id" plus contact email and name fields).
[Required] [Next Step]: Re-run EMELIA_LIST_CAMPAIGN_CONTACTS (paginate if needed) to confirm newly added contacts and updated count.
[Optional (if audit/verification needed)] [Next Step]: Inspect enrollment/activity using EMELIA_GET_CAMPAIGN_ACTIVITIES.
[Optional (if rollback needed after mistaken adds, after user confirmation)] [Step]: Remove contacts using EMELIA_DELETE_CONTACT_FROM_CAMPAIGN.
known_pitfalls: [EMELIA_ADD_CONTACT_TO_CAMPAIGN] Campaign identifier parameter is named "id", while EMELIA_LIST_CAMPAIGN_CONTACTS uses "campaignId".
[EMELIA_ADD_CONTACT_TO_CAMPAIGN] Missing required contact fields (email/name) can block enrollment.
[EMELIA_ADD_CONTACT_TO_CAMPAIGN] Can fail with status_code 400 indicating the contact is already included; treat as idempotent success or pre-check via EMELIA_LIST_CAMPAIGN_CONTACTS.
[EMELIA_LIST_CAMPAIGN_CONTACTS] Page-based pagination is required; collect pages until no more items rather than relying on a single call.

[EMELIA_LIST_CAMPAIGN_CONTACTS] Response includes both "count" and a "list" array; empty results may be "count": 0 with "list": [] (and nested executions may place lists under results[i].response.data.list).

id.description: Campaign ID to which the contact will be added
